mapper.select: SELECT n.note_id AS noteId, n.semester_label AS semesterLabel, n.display_name AS displayName, n.user_id AS userId, u.name AS authorName, u.login_id AS authorLoginId, n.content, n.font, n.ink, n.paper, n.align, n.tilt, n.state, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM guestbook_notes n LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = n.user_id WHERE n.semester_label = #{semester} ORDER BY n.note_id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT semester_label FROM guestbook_notes ORDER BY semester_label DESC
